title: Developer Attitudes and Practices Towards Optimizing Software Energy Consumption
abstract: arXiv:2608.30527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Software significantly influences the efficiency with which hardware resources are utilized, yet software energy consumption is seldom treated as a first-class concern in day-to-day development practice. Objective: This study investigates professional developers' attitudes, decision-making, and development practices related to software energy consumption, with particular emphasis on how energy considerations are recognized, assessed, and acted upon during software development. translated_title: 开发者对优化软件能耗的态度与实践
translated_abstract: 背景：软件显著影响着硬件资源的利用效率，然而在日常开发实践中，软件能耗很少被当作首要关注点。目标：本研究调查了专业开发者对软件能耗的态度、决策和开发实践，特别关注在软件开发过程中能耗因素是如何被识别、评估和付诸行动的。方法：为此，我们对134名软件开发者开展了在线调查。本研究将定量分析与对自由文本回答的定性开放卡片分类相结合，以刻画围绕能耗的认知、实践和推理模式。发现：只有少数项目会明确考虑能耗问题。更常见的情况是，开发者通过优化执行时间等代理属性间接地影响能耗。
tldr: 该研究通过对134名软件开发者的在线调查发现，软件能耗在日常开发中很少被作为首要关注点，开发者通常只是通过优化执行时间等代理属性间接影响软件能耗。
en_tdlr: Through an online survey of 134 software developers, this study finds that software energy consumption is rarely treated as a first-class concern in daily development, with developers more commonly influencing energy use indirectly by optimizing proxy properties such as execution time.
